CSS classes handling layout grids (.searchLayout, .mapWorkspace, .detailGallery) improperly hardcode 'direction: ltr' to force visual ordering of columns. In an RTL Arabic interface, the container should remain RTL, and columns should either flow naturally from right-to-left or utilize the 'order' property for specific visual placements. Forcing LTR on the container and reverting to RTL on children breaks semantic alignment and standard accessibility expectations.
